messages:
mike_runtime: Heads up — after yesterday's release (v1.14.2) we see a sustained ~35-45% drop in tokens/sec for some workloads. Not universal, seems to show up during worker startup and when sequence lengths vary.

anya_sre: Yikes. Any error logs or traces? Is this on dedicated or hosted?

mike_runtime: Hosted, single-region. Logs show normal GPU utilization but batch sizes are much smaller than before for the same arrival rate. Queueing time before batch construction is higher (~120ms vs ~15ms).

sam_perf: Do you have a timeline? Could be the kernel-selector change that landed in the runtime scheduler last night. It changed the selection heuristic for small sequences.

mike_runtime: Timeline matches — deploy at 01:12 UTC. I pulled pprof of the scheduler during the spike and saw most time in "BatchBuilder::gather" and "KVCache::probe_path". Attaching excerpts below.

mike_runtime: ```
CPU: profile 250ms samples
  40%  runtime:BatchBuilder::gather
  30%  runtime:KernelSelector::score
  15%  runtime:KVCache::probe_path
  10%  runtime::poll_loop
```

jen_bisect: I already kicked off a perf CI run on the merge commit for kernel-selector heuristic. CI reported +28% tail batch latency on azure-gpu-small.

ci-bot: perf-ci: job perf/throughput/azure-gpu-small #342 reported regression: tokens/sec -30% (p<0.01). See https://ci/reports/342

anya_sre: Interesting KVCache::probe_path appearing in flame graph. Is the selector causing different prefetch paths so KV hits drop? Could lead to smaller effective batching since cache warmup delayed.

sam_perf: I reproduced locally with a replay of the exact traffic shape. The new selector prefers a different kernel for short sequences, but the kernel path disables a quick KV hint that used to warm the shared KV hotset. So warmup window stretched.

mike_runtime: That matches the prod traces: first ~30s after worker start throughput low, then ramps as KV hits improve. But before v1.14.2 the ramp was almost instant.

jen_bisect: Running git bisect now between 9f2a8 (previous) and HEAD. If it's the selector change we can revert that small bit while we fix the KV hint plumbing.

sam_perf: Patch idea: kernel-selector should maintain KV hint on the fast path. Quick test patch (not yet validated):
```
diff --git a/runtime/kernel_selector.rs b/runtime/kernel_selector.rs
+ if candidate.prefers_short_seq() {
+    ensure_kv_hint_enabled();
+ }
```

anya_sre: Can we hold rollout on the host fleet? Recommend canary freeze and throttle traffic to older revision while we confirm.

mike_runtime: Put a hold on the automated rollout, set canary to 0. ops-bot — please pin hosted pool to v1.14.1 for now.

ops-bot: pinned hosted-pool region-eu-west to v1.14.1; automated rollout halted; alerting on tokens/sec deviations remains enabled.

jen_bisect: Bisect snapshot: bad commit is 0b4c9f3 (runtime: kernel selector rewrite). Opening revert PR now, will include perf regression numbers and trace comparisons.

sam_perf: If revert looks clean, ship revert to prod canary and monitor KV hitrate + batch sizes. Also add a unit test that asserts kernel path preserves KV hint semantics for short sequences.

mike_runtime: Agreed. After revert, if tokens/sec returns, we can plan a follow-up that reintroduces the selector but keeps KV-path compatibility.

anya_sre: I'll coordinate an incident postmortem for the rollout blocker once this stabilizes. Link to current retro draft: https://docs/reports/ctb-regression-draft

mike_runtime: Thanks all — I'll post perf graphs after revert lands. Quick checklist:
- jen_bisect: open revert PR (in progress)
- sam_perf: add KV hint regression unit and small replay test
- anya_sre: canary hold and postmortem draft
- ops-bot: keep pinned until mike confirms throughput normal

ops-bot: acknowledged, will maintain pin until explicit unpin command.

mike_runtime: Final note: the regression surface was subtle because overall GPU % stayed similar; if you only look at avg latency you'd miss the batch-construction stall. Keep an eye on batch_size_hist and kv_hit_ratio in console dashboards.

jen_bisect: Revert PR opened: https://phabricator/r/PR5243 — requesting review from @sam_perf and @mike_runtime

sam_perf: Reviewing now. If all green on canary, we do a fast rollback and then a targeted fix.

mike_runtime: I'll watch canary and report back in thread with graphs.

jen_bisect: last update: canary shows tokens/sec back to baseline within 90s of revert. Rolling to remaining hosts.

mike_runtime: Confirmed — kv_hit_ratio recovered and batch sizes returned to prior distribution. Closing hold after monitoring window. Great work. :tada:
